body_long:
Rosewood Hotel Group has appointed Sam Cooper as Vice President, Wellness, Global, based in New York. He joins after leading wellness strategy across 38 ultra-luxury properties and projects at Discovery Land Company.

The appointment is one of three senior roles announced together in October 2026. Gaye Gibson becomes Vice President, Retail and Partnerships, Global, based in Hong Kong, and Friedrich von Schönburg is promoted to Vice President, Operations, Asia-Pacific and Operations Excellence, Global, also in Hong Kong. All three report to Anthony Ingham, who became the group's chief operating officer in September 2025.

## The new team

Sam Cooper brings more than 25 years in luxury hospitality and wellness. Before Discovery Land Company he held several leadership roles at Canyon Ranch. At Rosewood he will steer the strategy and development of the group's global wellness platform, working across operations, design, brand and commercial teams to weave wellness into the whole guest journey.

Gaye Gibson previously led global retail at Maybourne Hotel Group and founded Azura Partners, a Hong Kong consultancy in retail strategy and commercial spaces for luxury hotel groups.

Friedrich von Schönburg has been managing director of Rosewood Villa Magna in Madrid since August 2022, as well as regional vice president for Spain and Italy.

## A group in growth mode

Rosewood Hotel Group, owned by Chow Tai Fook Enterprises, manages more than 50 properties in 25 countries and territories under the Rosewood, New World, Asaya and Carlyle & Co brands, with more than 30 projects in development. Rosewood Red Sea opened in August, Shenzhen is expected at the end of 2026, and Milan, Rome, Mexico and Crete are listed for 2027.

## The signal

Wellness is moving from the spa menu to the leadership table. When a group gives it a global vice president working with design and commercial teams, it shapes how hotels are conceived, priced and sold. The same logic applies to retail: Rosewood wants guests to carry the experience home, through boutiques and e-commerce.

Congratulations to Sam Cooper, Gaye Gibson and Friedrich von Schönburg.
